_about: q4_install.py --answers: the dialogs web/index_pkg.html can raise (its English texts: headless Chrome's language is en; web/fm1ota.js raises none), each with the answer the case needs. A rule matches a dialog whose text starts with `starts` (the longest match wins); any other dialog is cancelled and stops the run. Keys: a step (a1-standard, a2-nightly, c1-stock, c2-nightly, d-repeat, b-nightly) or a case; a step's own list wins.

a1-standard.starts: No other place is free, so the module that is in the unit is erased first.
a1-standard.why: modInPlaceConfirm: the Standard's module goes in place (the page's own path; it can be installed again)

a1-standard.starts: The set you ticked does not fit beside the modules as they sit in the FM-1 now. The page can take
a1-standard.why: rearrangeConfirm: the set's own modules taken off and put back in an order that fits (nothing dropped)

a2-nightly.starts: No other place is free, so the module that is in the unit is erased first.
The set you ticked does not fit beside the modules as they sit in the FM-1 now. The page can take
a2-nightly.why: rearrangeConfirm: the Nightly's set over the Standard's modules

c1-stock.starts: Has the complete backup file been saved to this computer? Continue to return to official V15.
c1-stock.why: stockConfirm: the page's backup was just downloaded into OUT (q4_install checks it is there and reads back after the step)

c2-nightly.starts: No other place is free, so the module that is in the unit is erased first.
c2-nightly.why: modInPlaceConfirm (not expected on a unit coming from stock: its module area is empty or another firmware's)

_not_answered_on_purpose: rearrangeDropConfirm / dropConfirm ('... is in the FM-1 but not in the set you ticked: the page removes it ...'): a module removed for good; no rule, so the run stops and the lead decides
stockConfirmNoBackup ('Return to official V15 without creating a backup?'): the tool never skips the page's backup
transitConfirm, fxRemoveConfirm: not reached by these cases
d-repeat and b-nightly: (d) must ask nothing (7.37), so any dialog stops it; (b) installs onto an empty module area, nothing to ask
